label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (sql-injection) alert-TP: The sink expression on line 22 constructs a SQL string 'q' by concatenating user input 'param' (derived from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest')) directly into the SQL syntax. The resolved sink value 'q' is attacker-controlled. Although execution is deferred via request.setAttribute, the construction of the dynamic SQL string represents a critical vulnerability vector that will be exploited upon retrieval and execution.

evidence.note: User input 'param' concatenated into SQL string 'q', then stored in request attribute.
